light.notes: Purple-leaf basil prefers strong light. Weak indoor light can reduce vigour and colour quality; this profile does not calculate a specific location's shade.

container.notes: Sources support container growing but do not establish a general pot-volume or depth figure for a broad Purple Basil type group.

water.notes: Use well-drained growing medium with regular moisture checks. Containers dry faster; do not infer a fixed watering amount.

establishment.notes: Establish in warm, frost-safe conditions. Purple cultivars may differ in speed, so no universal month is inferred.

unknowns: Whether the broad Purple Basil entry should become cultivar-specific.
